purpose: Positive/negative control: does each detection design fire on a model KNOWN to be watermarked (ON) and stay null when it is not (OFF)? The ON/OFF contrast on one model cancels base-model determinism and isolates the watermark.
statistic: ETH Red-Green (cross-prefix k-consistency vs 10000-permutation null, median over 100 bootstraps)

verdicts.repeat: BLIND — null even ON (repeated-context masking hides the mark). Confirms the masking hypothesis and a real blind spot in the published ETH design.
verdicts.random: VALID DETECTOR — fires ON (p=0.00), null OFF (p=0.65). Base determinism does not false-positive it.
